reviews.review_description:
After trying several times to install this game without success, I contacted Visual Lab, who discovered there was an issue with the installation process. Once this was fixed, I was finally able to access the game.

To be honest, the game itself isn’t great. The only feature I really liked was being able to use my own music through Spotify. Other than that, the gameplay is extremely limited — it’s basically just a leaderboard and either a 2,5,&  minute skipping session. That’s pretty much the entire experience. Oh you can also change your rope!! 

There are a few background scenes you can switch between, but beyond that, there’s very little to keep things interesting. I could honestly just grab a skipping rope, put on my headphones, and do the same thing anywhere . 

There are no extra modes, challenges, or progression systems, so the game quickly becomes repetitive and boring. I’m very glad I got it for free because if I had paid for it, I would definitely be asking for a refund.

The game really needs more exciting content and features added to make it feel worthwhile.

developer_response.body: Thank you for your feedback! We're taking your suggestions into account, and we think you'll be pleasantly surprised by next application version.

reviews.review_description: The rope mechanics are surprisingly realistic — after a few minutes you're genuinely out of breath. Clean interface, easy to get into, and the workout programs actually deliver results. No space, no equipment needed. A solid addition to any fitness routine.
Great workout app and the mixed reality mode is really fun. Tracking works well, but I'd love to see even more workout programs in future updates

It's been amazing to see how this app keeps getting better every week. The developers clearly listen to their community and continue adding meaningful improvements. The latest update with the stereoscopic girl really impressed me it feels much more immersive. I also love the new jump rope customization feature

developer_response.body: Thanks for being part of our community! We're continuing to make the app even better

reviews.review_description: A great addition to this would be adding double Dutch, like in the Quid Game, and of course multiplayer.
